description: This file defines the Configuration class for AWS SDK's Defaults Mode, managing various configuration settings and modes related to AWS service defaults.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Manages AWS SDK default configurations and modes, including validation, loading configuration data, and providing accessors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes configuration based on mode, validating input and loading default or mode-specific settings.

methods.name: getStsRegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns the STS regional endpoints setting.

methods.name: getS3UsEast1RegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns the S3 US East 1 regional endpoints setting.

methods.name: getConnectTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the connection timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: getHttpRequestTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all configuration settings as an associative array.
